svg.text: EV Fleet Analytics — Fully Automated Nightly Pipeline
project-623b2045-f641-41e7-894 · asia-south1 · Cloud Workflows orchestrated · zero manual steps
SA: ev-workflow-runner · serverless · free ≤5000 steps/month · ~15 steps/run
Cloud Workflow itself (calls BQ + Run API)
Can CREATE objects in bucket only.
Cannot read, delete, or access any
Used by: Cloud Build (image build), Dataflow workers, Dataproc workers
Note: these are project-level grants. In production each service should have
its own dedicated SA. This is acceptable for a learning project.
Used by the Pub/Sub managed service to write to ev_raw.telemetry_stream
ON-DEMAND / PERIODIC PHASES (not in daily workflow — run manually or triggered separately)
parse → drop invalid → enrich → BQ write
Key lesson: all Beam fns must be self-contained
(drain immediately after use — bills per VM/sec)
Dataflow (4b) replaced by BQ SQL in the nightly workflow: for daily batch enrichment, SQL is correct.
Dataflow justified when: complex windowing, late data, exactly-once semantics, streaming aggregations.
Dataproc justified when: billions of rows, non-SQL logic, existing Spark codebases, ML libraries.
Cloud Workflows chosen over Composer: Composer runs a GKE cluster (~$300/mo). Workflows is serverless,
free ≤5000 steps/month, and sufficient for a sequential DAG with polling. Composer adds value at scale.
COMPLETE AUTOMATION SUMMARY — zero manual steps in production flow
Total elapsed: ~5 min end to end
